verdict.rationale: BILL documents custom approval policies, and its bill-approval docs describe rules that control which bills need approval, by whom, and when. That is a real approval-policy capability, but the docs are AP-focused and say nothing about chained manager → budget owner → finance steps for Spend & Expense requests. missing for 10: documented multi-step sequential approval chains, approver roles such as budget owner, delegation of approval authority, escalation or auto-reassignment when approvers are idle, S&E-specific approval docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: A bill approval policy is a set of rules that enables you to control which bills require approval, by whom, and when.
